import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_MOD_N = 1024000;
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static Mod[] fact = new Mod[MAX_MOD_N];
    static Mod[] factinv = new Mod[MAX_MOD_N];
    static Map<Integer, Integer> mp = new HashMap<>();

    static class Mod {
        int num;
        Mod() {
            this.num = 0;
        }
        Mod(long n) {
            this.num = (int)((n % mod + mod) % mod);
        }
        Mod(int n) {
            this.num = n;
        }
        public int intValue() {
            return num;
        }
        public static Mod operatorPlus(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod((a.num + b.num) % mod);
        }
        public static Mod operatorPlus(Long a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(a) + b;
        }
        public static Mod operatorPlus(Mod a, Long b) {
            return b + a;
        }
        public static Mod operatorMinus(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(((long)mod + a.num - b.num) % mod);
        }
        public static Mod operatorMinus(Long a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(a) - b;
        }
        public static Mod operatorMultiply(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(((long)a.num * b.num) % mod);
        }
        public static Mod operatorMultiply(Long a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(a) * b;
        }
        public static Mod operatorMultiply(Mod a, Long b) {
            return new Mod(b) * a;
        }
        public static Mod operatorMultiply(Mod a, int b) {
            return new Mod(b) * a;
        }
        public static Mod operatorPlusAssign(Mod a, Mod b) {
            a.num = (a.num + b.num) % mod;
            return a;
        }
        public static Mod operatorMinusAssign(Mod a, Mod b) {
            a.num = ((long)mod + a.num - b.num) % mod;
            return a;
        }
        public static Mod operatorMultiplyAssign(Mod a, Mod b) {
            a.num = ((long)a.num * b.num) % mod;
            return a;
        }
        public static Mod operatorPlus(Mod a, int n) {
            return new Mod(n) + a;
        }
        public static Mod operatorMinus(Mod a, int n) {
            return new Mod(n) - a;
        }
        public static Mod operatorMultiply(Mod a, int b) {
            return new Mod(b) * a;
        }
        public static Mod pow(Mod a, int n) {
            if (n == 0) return new Mod(1);
            Mod res = pow(a, n / 2);
            res = res * res;
            if (n % 2 == 1) res = res * a;
            return res;
        }
        public static Mod inv(Mod a) {
            return pow(a, mod - 2);
        }
        public static Mod div(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return a * inv(b);
        }
    }

    static void init(int amax) {
        fact[0] = new Mod(1);
        factinv[0] = new Mod(1);
        for (int i=0; i<amax-1; i++) {
            fact[i+1] = fact[i] * new Mod(i+1);
            factinv[i+1] = factinv[i] / new Mod(i+1);
        }
    }

    static Mod comb(int a, int b) {
        return fact[a] * factinv[b] * factinv[a-b];
    }

    static void initMap() {
        List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(0, 0, 0));
        for (int i=0; i<3; ++i) v.add(1);
        int id=0;
        do {
            int tt=0;
            for (int k=0; k<6; ++k) {
                if (v.get(k) != 0) {
                    tt ^= (1 << k);
                }
            }
            mp.put(tt, id);
            id++;
        } while (nextPermutation(v));
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> v) {
        int i = v.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v.get(i) >= v.get(i + 1)) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = v.size() - 1;
        while (v.get(j) <= v.get(i)) j--;
        Collections.swap(v, i, j);
        int left = i + 1;
        int right = v.size() - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            Collections.swap(v, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static List<Mod> solve(List<List<Mod>> pers, int al) {
        List<Mod> l_nums = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(1 << 20, new Mod()));
        for (int xx=0; xx<(1<<18); ++xx){
            List<List<Integer>> haves = new ArrayList<>();
            for(int i=0; i<3; ++i) {
                haves.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(6, 0)));
            }
            Mod per = new Mod(1);
            for (int i=0; i<3; ++i) {
                for (int j=0; j<6; ++j) {
                    int k = i * 6 + j;
                    if ((xx & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                        haves.get(i).set(j, 1);
                        per = per * pers.get(al+i).get(j);
                    } else {
                        per = per * (new Mod(1) - pers.get(al + i).get(j));
                    }
                }
            }
            int flags=0;
            for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
                if (haves.get(0).get(i)==0) continue;
                for (int j=0; j<6; ++j) {
                    if (haves.get(1).get(j)==0) continue;
                    if (i==j) continue;
                    for (int k=0; k<6; ++k) {
                        if (haves.get(2).get(k)==0) continue;
                        if (i==k || j==k) continue;
                        int anum=0;
                        int mask=0;
                        int value = (1<<i) | (1<<j) | (1<<k);
                        mask = value;
                        Integer key=mask;
                        int index=mp.getOrDefault(key, -1);
                        if(index != -1) flags|=(1<<index);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flags >= l_nums.size()) continue;
            l_nums.set(flags, l_nums.get(flags).operatorPlus(per));
        }
        return l_nums;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        init(MAX_MOD_N);
        List<List<Mod>> pers = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i=0; i<6; ++i) {
            List<Mod> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j=0; j<6; ++j) {
                row.add(new Mod(0));
            }
            pers.add(row);
        }

        initMap();

        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int s = 3 - (N + 1) / 2;
        for (int i=0; i<s; ++i)
            pers.get(i).set(i, new Mod(1));
        for (int i=s; i<s+N; ++i) {
            for (int j=s; j<s+N; ++j) {
                int p = sc.nextInt();
                pers.get(i).set(j, new Mod(p) / new Mod(100));
            }
        }
        for (int i=s+N; i<6; ++i)
            pers.get(i).set(i, new Mod(1));

        List<Mod> u_nums = solve(pers, 0);
        List<Mod> d_nums = solve(pers, 3);
        for (int x=1; x<(1<<20); x<<=1) {
            for (int i=0; i<(1<<20); ++i) {
                if ((i & x) == 0) {
                    d_nums.set(i ^ x, d_nums.get(i ^ x) + d_nums.get(i));
                }
            }
        }
        Mod answer = new Mod(0);
        for (int i=0; i<(1<<20); ++i) {
            if (u_nums.get(i).intValue() != 0) {
                int need=0;
                for (int x=0; x<20; ++x) {
                    if ((i & (1<<x)) != 0) {
                        need|=(1<<(19 - x));
                    }
                }
                int pp = ((1<<20) - 1) ^ i;
                Mod nanswer = u_nums.get(i) * (new Mod(1) - d_nums.get(((1<<20) - 1) ^ need));
                answer = answer + nanswer;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.intValue());
        sc.close();
    }
}
